[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Bewil''' was a tactical officer from [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]]. He was assigned to [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] due to his ability to use a computer to lure enemies into tactically weak positions.

==Biography==
Accompanied by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Bewil informed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] had arrived at [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Darth Vader then told him to make sure that Luke made it into the carbonite freezing chamber, where he would be frozen and delivered to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. In an effort to direct Skywalker to Vader, Bewil controlled Cloud City's lift tubes and hatchways. Bewil cut off Skywalker's pursuit of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sheckil/Legends|Sheckil]] and his stormtroopers holding [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] hostage by closing a nearby [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]], along with other nearby doors, ultimately directing Skywalker to the waiting Vader. Presumably, he may have also been responsible for sealing the [[Core Tunnel]] after Skywalker exited it during the [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|ensuing duel]] between the two to further direct him to Vader.<ref name="Episode V" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Kershner_and_Johns.png|thumb|left|180px|Director [[Irvin Kershner]] on the set of ''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'', with Milton Johns in the background]]
Bewil appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], in which he was played by [[Milton Johns]]. Bewil appears twice in the film during the carbon-freezing scene, first to announce that Skywalker's X-wing was inbound and second to inform Vader that Skywalker had landed, but his voice is substantially deeper when he reports the latter.

In the [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel]] [[Classic Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (comic series)|comic adaptation]] of ''The Empire Strikes Back'', versions of Bewil's two lines of dialogue are given to a stormtrooper present in the carbon-freezing chamber. In the [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|radio adaptation]], the first line is spoken by a stormtrooper,<ref name="Dark Lord's Fury">{{ESBRadio|Dark Lord's Fury}}</ref> while the second comes from an officer identifiable as Bewil.<ref name="Gambler's Choice">{{ESBRadio|Gambler's Choice}}</ref>
